title: Infonet suspends customer websites after unauthorized access to infoCMS shared server
summary: Infonet says unauthorized access from outside was confirmed on part of the shared servers for its infoCMS content management system. It suspended public access to the websites on the affected server on 21 November. Its notice says it is still identifying the scope and does not say whether data was accessed or stolen; Cybersecurity.com (Japan) adds that related systems and dedicated-server customers are being checked.
plain: Infonet found outside access to a shared server for its infoCMS website system and took the customer sites on it offline. It has not said whether any data was taken.
exec: Customer websites on the affected infoCMS shared server are offline while the scope is investigated.
action: Infonet's notice gives no steps for customers beyond contacting its support desk.
geo_basis: Infonet's location is not stated in the sources; pin placed at Tokyo as a country-level marker

validation.note: Infonet (primary notice) and Cybersecurity.com (Japan) are two publishers that each state the unauthorized access and the suspension.
